paper_record.title: Omnidirectional photonic chiral flatband in nonlocal membrane metasurfaces
paper_record.abstract: Omnidirectional flat-band resonances, characterized by an enhanced photonic density of states and inherent angular robustness, are highly sought-after in integrated nanophotonic devices, particularly when integrated with chiral functionality. Here we realize such resonances in a nonlocal silicon membrane metasurface patterned with periodic square-lattice air-hole arrays. Increasing the lattice period not only compresses the Brillouin zone but, crucially, weakens the evanescent coupling between neighbouring Bloch modes associated with the same-order guided resonances. Driven by the tight-binding model in the limit of weak inter-unit-cell coupling, the pronounced band flattening of the degenerate guided resonance along both $k_{x}$ and $k_{y}$ yields, giving rise to an omnidirectional flat-band resonance. Remarkably, both numerical simulations and experiments reveal a universal route for endowing flat-band guided resonances with optical chirality through the deliberate breaking of the mirror symmetry of air holes. As a result, the omnidirectional chiral flat-band resonance emerges along both principal in-plane directions, with $Q$-factors exceeding 10$^{3}$ and circular dichroism greater than 0.9 over a wide angular range of $\pm 5^{\circ}$. Nonlinear measurements further show that the resulting resonance not only drives highly efficient third-harmonic generation but also imparts a pronounced spin-selective character to the nonlinear process. Simultaneously, the highly efficient nonlinear process also enables chirality-controlled frequency-upconversion imaging. Our results establish a general paradigm for engineering omnidirectional chiral flat-band resonances in planar silicon platforms, opening new opportunities for nonlinear nanophotonics and chiral imaging.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 在非局域硅膜超构表面中实现了全向手性平带共振，并应用于高效非线性成像。
one_sentence_summary.en: Realization of omnidirectional chiral flat-band resonances in nonlocal silicon membrane metasurfaces for enhanced nonlinear imaging.

problem.zh: 传统的纳米光子平带通常局限于特定波矢方向，且难以同时实现高品质因子（Q值）、强手性响应和全向角度鲁棒性。
problem.en: Conventional photonic flat bands are often limited to specific wavevector directions and struggle to simultaneously achieve high Q-factors, strong chirality, and omnidirectional angular robustness.

approach.zh: 利用周期性方晶格硅膜超构表面，通过增大晶格周期减弱布洛赫模式间的耦合以实现带平坦化，并通过打破空气孔的镜像对称性引入光学手性。
approach.en: Utilizing a square-lattice silicon membrane metasurface, the authors weaken coupling between Bloch modes by increasing the lattice period to achieve band flattening, and introduce chirality by breaking the mirror symmetry of the air holes.

main_takeaway.zh: 实验证实了在±5°角度范围内具有高Q值（>1000）和高圆二色性（>0.9）的全向手性平带，并实现了空间分辨率约3.2微米的手性选择性非线性频率上转换成像。
main_takeaway.en: Experiments confirmed an omnidirectional chiral flat band with Q > 1000 and circular dichroism > 0.9 over a ±5° range, enabling spin-selective nonlinear frequency-upconversion imaging with ~3.2 μm resolution.

why_it_matters.zh: 该研究为在平面硅平台上工程化全向手性平带提供了通用范式，对非线性纳米光子学、手性光与物质相互作用及集成光子器件具有重要意义。
why_it_matters.en: This work establishes a general paradigm for engineering omnidirectional chiral flat bands on planar silicon platforms, significant for nonlinear nanophotonics, chiral light-matter interactions, and integrated devices.

reason.zh: 首次在非局域超构表面中同时实现了全向性、高Q值和强手性的平带共振，并展示了其在非线性成像中的应用。
reason.en: It is the first to simultaneously achieve omnidirectionality, high Q-factor, and strong chirality in flat-band resonances within nonlocal metasurfaces, demonstrating practical nonlinear imaging applications.

reason.zh: 论文结合了创新的物理机制（全向手性平带）与高质量的实验验证（非线性成像），符合该期刊的质量要求。
reason.en: The paper combines innovative physical mechanisms (omnidirectional chiral flat bands) with high-quality experimental validation (nonlinear imaging), fitting the journal's standards.
